title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps draw several curves in red, green and blue; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette and line styles that stay distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-02/app.html`, `sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Curves distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Fourier features to the heat-equation network
body:
## Problem
The shipped network fails on a start such as sin(3 pi x): the relative L2 error is above 0.3.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, first milestone. Small tanh networks learn smooth patterns first (spectral bias).

## Expected outcome
A `fourier_features` option for the Session 3 network with the derivative formulas worked out by hand and checked against finite differences.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Derivatives verified by finite differences

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 4: exact boundary and initial conditions
body:
## Problem
The shipped network only penalises the boundary and initial conditions, so the end temperatures are not exactly 0.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Largest |u| at the ends is exactly 0
- [ ] Checkpoint added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: learn the field and the diffusivity together
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a network recovering both the heat-map and the diffusivity from 25 sparse noisy readings; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Recovered alpha within 2 percent on the default readings
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
